topic: Pablo Escobar's hippos: four became about two hundred, and Colombia has approved a cull

sentences.text: Pablo Escobar's hippos are still alive.
And Colombia has approved killing more than eighty of them.
To understand why, you have to go back to 1981.
sentences.editorial: turn to context, not a factual claim

sentences.text: Escobar imports four hippos for his private zoo.
His estate sits between Medellín and Bogotá.
In 1993 he dies, and the hippos escape.
But most conservationists call them invasive.
So in April 2026, Colombia approves killing over eighty.
An Indian billionaire offers to take them to India instead.
But some ecologists say they should stay.
Escobar is gone, but his hippos are not.
